formal_role: Derivative-based sensitivity is local to a point or parameter value
systems_modeling_role: Keeps marginal response tied to a specific system condition
review_warning: Do not generalize local sensitivity across the whole domain without evidence

formal_role: Elasticity requires nonzero input and output for proportional interpretation
review_warning: Elasticity is unreliable or undefined near zero

formal_role: Log-derivative interpretation requires positive input and output
review_warning: Negative or sign-changing quantities require special handling

formal_role: Numerical derivatives depend on perturbation size
review_warning: Step sizes that are too large or too small can distort the result

formal_role: Sensitivity depends on the range of values examined
review_warning: A narrow range may hide nonlinear or threshold behavior
